hypothesis: Logistic regression baseline on 19 GEMSDOE training features predicts fault probability; sparse top-k emission at threshold 0.3 within footprint, excluding known catalogue traces.
mechanism: Linear combination of 19 geophysical/geomorphic bands (mag_anom, rtp, tmi_hg, geod_2ndinv, iso_grav_anom_slope, tc, geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate, tmi_vg, deq_n100a15, iso_grav_anom_vg, det_elev, iso_grav_anom, tmi, depth_to_base_surf, ieq_n100a15, cond_surf, iso_grav_anom_hg, det_elev_slope) fitted via logistic regression on a 100k-sample spatial subsample; prediction surface emitted as dots above probability threshold 0.3.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, survey block boundaries, cultural alignment, levelling seams, and basin-fill contacts can produce similar potential-field and topographic signatures without representing active faults.
